_doc: Themes: stories that run over several rooms of the dungeon, so a run meets a few rooms of one in a row (a forgotten battlefield, a frozen vein, the aftermath of a fire) before moving on. A piece joins a theme by naming it in its 'themes'; a piece may be in several, and its biome still decides its floor and walls. 'run' is how many rooms in a row a theme lasts in the showcase (run.cmd --showcase), fewer if it has fewer pieces. A theme can also dress its rooms: 'ground' recolours the floor (as a biome's), 'fill' tints the soft light over each room ('color' and 'energy', in place of the biome's in data/lights.json), and 'clutter' replaces the biome's loose props on the open floor ('share' of them; the rest stay the biome's). Games ignore all of it for now; one that uses themes should place pieces of one theme near each other.

themes.name: The Long Mourning
themes.lore: The crypts where the old city buried its dead and kept on mourning them. The candles are still lit; somebody tends them.

themes.name: The Plague Year
themes.lore: In the plague year the dead came faster than the living could bury them. These are the rooms where they gave up trying.

themes.name: Bones of the Dead God
themes.lore: Something vast died down here before there were people to see it. Its bones became the walls, and cults grew in them like moss.

themes.name: Skrag's Warband
themes.lore: War-chief Skrag's goblins hold these tunnels: stockades, watch posts and drums that carry word of strangers ahead of them.

themes.name: The Goblin Hovels
themes.lore: Where the goblins actually live, cook, sleep and hoard. It smells exactly as you would expect.

themes.name: The Lost Delve
themes.lore: A dwarven mine abandoned when the seams ran deep and strange. Its rails, carts and props are still where the miners dropped them.

themes.name: The Singing Veins
themes.lore: Crystal grows through the rock here, humming as it grows. Miners, cultists and engine-wrights have all come to listen and to take.

themes.name: The Bloom
themes.lore: Fungus, moss and pale trees that have never seen the sun, lit by their own glow. Breathe shallowly.

themes.name: The Untrodden Deep
themes.lore: Raw caves no one built and few have walked: stone teeth, fallen slabs and the remains of the ones who came alone.

themes.name: The Engine Deep
themes.lore: The machines that pump, lift and grind for the deep, still running long after anyone remembers how.

themes.name: The Smiths' Quarter
themes.lore: Forges, stores and yards of the deep smiths, who made the dungeon's iron and still keep their fires lit.

themes.name: The Molten Heart
themes.lore: Where the forges dug too deep and found the fire that was already there. The rock runs hot and the altars face it.

themes.name: The Last Court
themes.lore: The Deep King's court: throne, galleries, feasts and fountains, kept ready for a king who went below and did not come back.

themes.name: The King's Bargain
themes.lore: The rooms where the Deep King's sorcerers studied what lived below, and where the king made his bargain with it.

themes.name: The Wardens' Keep
themes.lore: Guard rooms, cells and trapped corridors: the keep's defences, still set against intruders long after the guards have gone.

themes.name: The Forgotten Battlefield
themes.lore: Two armies met in these halls and neither marched out. The dead still lie where they fell, in their ranks, with their banners.

themes.name: The Frosted Veins
themes.lore: A cold that is not winter seeps up from something frozen far below. Ice splits the stone, and snow falls from a stone sky.

themes.name: The Great Burning
themes.lore: Something set the deep alight and the fire ran through these rooms for days. Everything is cinder and black stone, and in places it is burning still.
